workflow.current_core_block:
core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Record portable environment
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            uname -a
            cat /etc/os-release
            swift --version
            python3 --version
            git rev-parse HEAD
          } | tee core-environment.log
      - name: Verify agent state and native source syntax
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/agent_cycle.py check
          python3 scripts/agent_cycle.py next
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'
          python3 scripts/native_test_shards.py check
          python3 scripts/verify_app_icon.py | tee icon-source.log
          python3 scripts/verify_privacy_manifest.py | tee privacy-source.log
          # Syntax only: Linux cannot type-check Apple SDK APIs.
          swiftc -frontend -parse App/*.swift UITests/*.swift NativeTests/*.swift 2>&1 | tee native-syntax.log
      - name: Portable debug tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swift test --jobs 2 2>&1 | tee core-tests.log
      - name: Portable release tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swift test --configuration release --jobs 2 2>&1 | tee core-release-tests.log
      - name: Verify atomic write failure and commit interruption on Linux
        timeout-minutes: 6
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/run_atomic_library_write_probe.py --with-commit-interruption \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/atomic-library-write-linux" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/atomic-library-write-linux.log"
      - name: Upload Linux atomic library write evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: atomic-library-write-linux-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/atomic-library-write-linux.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/atomic-library-write-linux/
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Render portable reference study images
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swiftc -O Sources/LightingCore/*.swift scripts/render-study-fixtures.swift -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/render-study"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/render-study" study-artifacts | tee study-render.log
          sha256sum study-artifacts/*.ppm | tee study-image-sha256.txt
      - name: Verify bounded Study performance workloads
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swiftc -O Sources/LightingCore/*.swift scripts/benchmark-study.swift -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-study"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-study" --samples 7 --revision "$GITHUB_SHA" > study-benchmark.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, math
          report = json.load(open("study-benchmark.json"))
          assert report["optimizedBuild"] is True
          assert report["measuredSamplesPerWorkload"] >= 7
          assert len(report["frames"]) == 8
          assert len(report["cancellation"]) == 12
          assert len(report["visibility"]) == 4
          assert all(f["unsupportedPixels"] == 0 for f in report["frames"])
          assert all(c["cancelled"] is True for c in report["cancellation"])
          for workload in report["frames"] + report["visibility"]:
              samples = workload["timing"]["samplesMilliseconds"]
              assert len(samples) >= 7 and all(math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0 for x in samples)
          print("Eight deterministic frames, twelve observed cancellations and four visibility workloads passed.")
          print("Host timings are diagnostics; no physical-device frame-rate, memory or thermal claim.")
          print("KEYFILL_BENCHMARK " + json.dumps(report, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
          PY
      - name: Compare shared Float32 kernel math against Swift CPU oracle
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swiftc -O Sources/LightingCore/*.swift scripts/prepare-kernel-fixtures.swift -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-kernel-fixtures"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-kernel-fixtures" "$RUNNER_TEMP/kernel-fixtures"
          clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror scripts/verify-kernel-host.cpp -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify-kernel-host"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify-kernel-host" "$RUNNER_TEMP"/kernel-fixtures/*.bin | tee study-kernel.log
      - name: Verify far-camera Float32 precision regressions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          swiftc -O Sources/LightingCore/*.swift scripts/precision-boundary.swift -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-precision-boundary"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-precision-boundary" "$RUNNER_TEMP/precision-boundary"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify-kernel-host" --maximum-channel-error 1 \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP"/precision-boundary/area-camera-*.bin \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP"/precision-boundary/world-translation-*.bin | tee study-precision.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: core-test-log
          path: |
            core-environment.log
            native-syntax.log
            icon-source.log
            privacy-source.log
            core-tests.log
            core-release-tests.log
            study-render.log
            study-image-sha256.txt
            study-kernel.log
            study-precision.log
            study-benchmark.json
            study-artifacts/
